b2-formal-nominalization.title: Formal Register Nominalizer: -moqlik
b2-formal-nominalization.explanation: Alongside the everyday -ish nominalizer, Uzbek has a more formal, bookish alternative built from -moq (the infinitive) plus -lik: o'qimoqlik ("the act of reading/studying") sits at a higher register than o'qish, and shows up more in academic or official writing than casual speech.
b2-formal-nominalization.fact: Because -moqlik is built directly on the infinitive/dictionary form rather than the bare stem, it reads as slightly more abstract and detached -- much the way English "the reading of" sounds more formal than the plain gerund "reading", even though both describe the identical action.

dialogue.en: How important is the preparing of this report?
Very important, the deadline is approaching.

b2-negative-conditional.title: Negative Conditional: -masa ("unless")
b2-negative-conditional.explanation: Adding the conditional -sa to an already-negated stem (-ma-) gives "unless": ishlamasang, pul topolmaysan (unless you work, you can't earn money -- literally "if you don't work"). It's the mirror image of the plain affirmative conditional covered earlier.
b2-negative-conditional.fact: Uzbek has no separate word for "unless" the way English does -- it's built compositionally from pieces already known (negative -ma, conditional -sa), which is why intermediate learners can produce it correctly the moment they've learned both suffixes separately, without memorizing anything new.

dialogue.native: Nima bo'lardi, agar u yordam bermasa?
dialogue.en: What would happen if he/she didn't help?

dialogue.native: U yordam bermasa, biz bu ishni bajara olmaymiz.
dialogue.en: Unless he/she helps, we can't complete this task.

items.en: Resolving this matter is necessary.
Preparing the report took quite a while.

items.uz: Qonunga rioya qilmoqlik har bir fuqaroning vazifasi.
items.en: Complying with the law is every citizen's duty.

items.uz: Bu qarorni qabul qilmoqlik oson emas edi.
items.en: Making this decision wasn't easy.
Checking the information is considered an important stage.

items.uz: Tilni mukammal bilmoqlik ko'p mehnat talab qiladi.
items.en: Knowing a language perfectly requires a lot of effort.
Introducing this system is being planned.
Discussing this matter is necessary.

items.uz: Natijalarni e'lon qilmoqlik keyingi haftaga belgilandi.
items.en: Announcing the results was scheduled for next week.

items.uz: Bunday qarorni qabul qilmoqlik mas'uliyat talab qiladi.
items.en: Making such a decision requires responsibility.

items.uz: Yangi qoidalarni o'rganmoqlik barcha uchun majburiy.
items.en: Learning the new rules is mandatory for everyone.
Preparing the documents was carried out step by step.
Unless you work, you can't earn money.

items.uz: U yordam bermasa, bu ishni bajara olmaymiz.
items.en: Unless he/she helps, we can't complete this task.

items.uz: Ko'p mashq qilmasang, tilni o'rgana olmaysan.
items.en: Unless you practice a lot, you can't learn the language.
Unless we leave early, we won't catch the train.
Unless the rain stops, we'll cancel the trip.
Unless you explain, I won't understand.
Unless he/she comes, we can't start.
Unless we prepare thoroughly, we'll face failure.

items.uz: Bu qoidalarga rioya qilmasangiz, jarima to'laysiz.
items.en: Unless you follow these rules, you'll pay a fine.
Unless we start earlier, we'll be late.
Unless you're patient, you can't achieve results.

items.uz: U meni kechirmasa, men juda xafa bo'laman.
items.en: Unless he/she forgives me, I'll be very upset.
